notes.title: New Demo Patch: 0.3e8
notes.notes:
Hi all, the long awaited bug fix patch for the Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic demo is finally dropping. This patch fixes all of the common bugs I'm aware of, including:


Accidentally exiting battles during the transition to daemon negotiation.

Doubled SP usage.

Incorrect damage values.

Bifrons accidentally 'summoning' himself instead of Avnas.

Incorrect number of attacks during the 'Beat Flurry' attack.

Progressing through the introduction without completing the required actions.

I apologise for the long wait between the demo release and this patch. This will not be the final patch to the demo - while I am mainly focused on making the main game content at the moment, there will be another patch focused more on QOL improvements and polish, including controller support and key rebinding. As I'm balancing working on new content with producing those QOL improvements, I don't want to put out a specific ETA for that patch, but stay tuned!

Thank you to everyone who has played so far for your patience and support!
